purpose: Recurring writing guidance for the current stretch of the story. This is creative direction, not permanent canon.
scene_goal: Write the next requested scene naturally from current_state.json.
relationship_freedom: Allow natural small talk and casual banter.
Allow harmless shared memories, past anecdotes, inside jokes, and ordinary feelings between established friends and family.
Treat harmless interpersonal details as scene-level invention unless they contradict hard canon, timeline, character knowledge, or an explicit story constraint.
avoid: Do not invent major plot events, consequential backstory, secret knowledge, or new relationships merely to fill space.
Do not reveal hidden canon early.
Do not turn optional creative details into permanent canon unless they are later established by the story.
